stock.description: Beijing Tong Ren Tang Healthcare Investment Co., Ltd. offers TCM healthcare services to individual customers and businesses in China. The company provides TCM healthcare services, including TCM medication and non-medication treatments; management services; and sale of healthcare products and other products. The company sells its products through suppliers and Tong Ren Tang brand name. Beijing Tong Ren Tang Healthcare Investment Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Beijing Tong Ren Tang Healthcare Industry Investment Group Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. Beijing Tong Ren Tang Healthcare Investment Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of China Beijing Tong Ren Tang Group Co. Ltd.
